Internal and external alterations and extensions to the building (including existing 3 residential units). Creation of new third floor level to facilitate the creation of 6 residential units (gross). Provision of cycle storage and refuse facilities at the ground floor level. New fenestration to the existing building and the creation of a balcony at second floor level facing the library.
